column3: After #17 landed: the Drive view has no share control and no share-link download path; the scope picker shows drive.scopes for the active conversation (Captain and automation scopes appear where the backend attaches them) and opens on the Captain scope in a Captain pane; its decisions move to tested functions in lib/drive.ts
column4: main has no drive.share, drive.unshare, `shares` in drive.list or GET /s/<id> (they are in open #24), so the contract's share UI and its 304/206/416 responses have nothing to call; there is no authenticated GET of a drive file either. Listing every Captain and automation scope would cost an extra captain.list and automation.list per open for scopes the open conversation cannot use
column5: web/src/lib/drive.test.ts, web/src/lib/loading.test.ts; browser walkthrough against wrangler dev on main
